title: Boulder'gor
wikitext:
[[Image:Boulder'gor.jpg|thumb|300px|Boulder'gor.]]
[[Boulder'gor]] is a hill found north of [[Stromgarde Keep]] in the [[Arathi Highlands]]. It is the hangout of several [[forest troll]]s, as well as several [[ogre]]s of the [[Boulderfist]] tribe, based out of the [[Boulderfist Outpost]] which has been carved into the hillside.
